verdict.rationale: Rippling's global payroll pages say it pays employees and contractors worldwide in one system. They also say it calculates and files payroll taxes for employees worldwide and covers global HR, payroll and compliance. That clearly supports running payroll for staff abroad, which fits the owned-entity path, and a customer quote cites running three countries in one system. Missing for 10: any explicit employer-of-record offering, explicit confirmation that the payroll runs through the customer's own foreign entities, country coverage details, and independent or hands-on corroboration of international employment.
